theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_diagonal_integral_blowup
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (Vi : ℕ → Varifold N n U) (V : Varifold N n U) (ξ : Euclidean N) (P : Grassmannian N n) (θ₀ c r : ℝ), Varifold.RadonConverges Vi V → (∀ i, IsIntegral (Vi i)) → (∀ i, (Vi i).HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation) → HasTangentPlane V ξ P θ₀ → 0 < r → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < r → liminf (fun i ↦ variationMeasure (Vi i) (closedBall ξ ρ)) atTop ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * ρ ^ n)) → ∃ W : ℕ → Varifold N n (ball (0 : Euclidean N) 5), (∀ k, IsIntegral (W k)) ∧ (∀ k, (W k).HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation) ∧ Tendsto (fun k ↦ variationMeasure (W k) (ball (0 : Euclidean N) 5)) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ ∀ f : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ), tsupport f ⊆ ball (0 : Euclidean N) 5 ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)) → Tendsto (fun k ↦ ∫ z, f z ∂(W k).measure) atTop (𝓝 (θ₀ * ∫ z, f z ∂(planeVarifoldMeasure P)))
